_about: Narration for the Storyraise Collect stories walkthrough (approved by Vince 2026-10-28). `text` is what viewers read in captions; [[cue:name]] markers are stripped before TTS and become timestamps visuals land on. Labels match the product UI (storyraise-collect branch public/js.js and compose/index.html; builder public/builder/index.html). American English, no em dashes. Value first: caveats (no QR or embed code in Collect, repeaters match tagged constituents with contains) live in the page FAQ and KB, not here.

scenes.title: Cold open
scenes.text: The best part of any impact report is the people in it. [[cue:brand]]Storyraise Collect gathers their stories, and your reports tell them.

scenes.title: Start a collection
scenes.text: [[cue:new]]Start a new collection [[cue:type]]and choose what you want to collect, like thank-yous from the students your donors support.

scenes.title: Build the form
scenes.text: [[cue:fields]]Add the fields you need: [[cue:short]]short text for a name, [[cue:long]]long text for their story, [[cue:upload]]and a file upload for a photo. [[cue:variable]]Each field saves to a variable, like student note.

scenes.title: Share the form
scenes.text: [[cue:link]]Get form link and send it however you like. [[cue:form]]Students answer on any device, photo and all.

scenes.title: Responses
scenes.text: [[cue:grid]]Every answer lands in the collection, one row per student, [[cue:review]]ready to review, edit, or export.

scenes.title: Add a repeater
scenes.text: [[cue:repeater]]In your report, add a repeater. [[cue:collection]]Under Repeat For Each Item in, select your collection. [[cue:card]]Then lay out one story card with variables like student name, [[cue:photo]]and set its image to the student's photo.

scenes.title: One card per story
scenes.text: [[cue:cards]]The repeater makes a card for every response. [[cue:new]]When a new story comes in, the report shows it too.
scenes._note: Cut 2026-10-28 after review: an unfiltered repeater renders nothing (report.js:4909-4911), so 'a card for every response' was not true. Its new-stories line moved to s09.

scenes.title: Make it personal
scenes.text: [[cue:when]]Now tell it which stories to show. Under Repeat When, [[cue:rule]]match the fund code each student entered to the fund reference on every donor's record. [[cue:result]]Each donor sees the students their own gift supports.

scenes.title: Preview two donors
scenes.text: [[cue:emily]]Emily Wilson's fund supports Sophia and David, [[cue:emilycards]]so theirs are the stories she reads. [[cue:james]]James Taylor sees Grace and Marcus instead. [[cue:new]]And when a new matching story comes in, it shows up the next time the report opens.

scenes.title: Close
scenes.text: [[cue:recap]]Collect the stories once, and every report tells the right ones.
